name: web-weather-uk-asks-fahrenheit
description: A UK user asks the weather in a US town in Fahrenheit (for a relative there); the pages give °F (stand-in web, fictional town). Right: °F, as asked — Yap's °C-first conversion of the pages (about_you::convert_temperatures) mustn't override a question that names the other scale. Run with --locale en-GB.
